name: useCamera
summary: Lens, zoom, flash and torch, plus taking photos and recording video.
plain: Drives the camera and captures from it. Give it a camera view to hold on to and it can take a still or record a clip, both of which land as real files you can play back, save to the gallery or send to a model. Note that the Pixel Camera app's own colour Looks and long-range zoom are not available to other apps.
description: The hook owns a ref to a CameraView and drives it, so a screen only renders the view and attaches cameraRef and handleCameraReady. takePicture resolves with a file, its dimensions and optionally base64 for the AI hooks; startRecording resolves when the recording ends, either because you called stopRecording or because a duration or size limit was reached. Two things the API does not make obvious: zoom is a 0 to 1 fraction of the lens range rather than an optical multiplier, so a "5x" figure does not map onto it; and Camera Looks, Super Res Zoom and the low-light video mode belong to the Pixel Camera app and cannot be driven from here, so selectedLook is a label for your own interface.

returns.name: cameraRef
returns.desc: Attach to your CameraView. Capture fails without it.

returns.name: viewProps
returns.desc: Spread onto the view so it reflects this hook's state.

returns.name: facing
returns.desc: Which camera is active.

returns.name: zoomFactor
returns.desc: Zoom as a 0 to 1 fraction of the lens range, not an optical multiplier.

returns.name: flashMode
returns.desc: Whether the flash fires at capture.

returns.name: isTorchOn
returns.desc: Continuous light, as distinct from the capture-time flash.

returns.name: mode
returns.desc: View configuration. Recording requires video.

returns.name: isReady
returns.desc: Whether the preview is running and capture is possible.

returns.name: hasPermission
returns.desc: Whether camera permission was granted.

returns.name: isCapturing
returns.desc: True while a still is being taken.

returns.name: lastPhoto
returns.desc: Most recent still: uri, width, height and optional base64 and exif.

returns.name: isRecording
returns.desc: True while video is recording.

returns.name: recordingSeconds
returns.desc: Elapsed seconds of the current recording.

returns.name: lastVideoUri
returns.desc: File of the most recent clip. Hand this to useVideo to play it back.

returns.name: availableLenses
returns.desc: Lens identifiers the device reports, once the preview is running.

returns.name: availablePictureSizes
returns.desc: Picture sizes the device supports.

returns.name: selectedLook
returns.desc: Label only. Looks are a Pixel Camera app feature and are not applied here.

returns.name: error
returns.desc: Why the last capture failed.

returns.name: source
returns.desc: Where the numbers came from. There is no 'simulated' value: a reading is real, derived from real readings, or unavailable.

returns.name: maxZoomFactor
returns.desc: App-side ceiling for that fraction; `1`.

returns.name: isUltraLowLightVideoActive
returns.desc: UI flag only, for the same reason.

actions.name: handleCameraReady()
actions.desc: Pass to the view's onCameraReady. Lens and picture-size lists only resolve once the preview is running, so they are read here.
actions.output: Resolves once isReady is set and availableLenses and availablePictureSizes have been filled.

actions.name: takePicture(options?)
actions.desc: Takes a still into the app cache. Use useMediaLibrary().save() to keep it.

inputs.name: options.base64
inputs.desc: Also return the image as base64, which is what the AI hooks consume. Defaults to false.

inputs.name: options.exif
inputs.desc: Include EXIF metadata. Defaults to false.

inputs.name: options.shutterSound
inputs.desc: Play the shutter sound where the platform allows suppressing it. Defaults to true.

actions.output: Resolves with { uri, width, height, base64?, exif? }, or null when the view is not mounted or the capture failed, with the reason in error.

actions.name: startRecording(options?)
actions.desc: Records video, switching the view to video mode first.

inputs.name: options.maxDurationSeconds
inputs.desc: Stop automatically after this many seconds.

inputs.name: options.maxFileSizeBytes
inputs.desc: Stop automatically at this file size.

inputs.name: options.mirror
inputs.desc: Mirror the recording, matching what the user saw on a front-facing preview.

actions.output: Resolves with the video file URI when recording ends — through stopRecording() or a limit — or null on failure. recordingSeconds ticks while it runs.

actions.name: stopRecording()
actions.desc: Ends the recording. No-op when nothing is recording.
actions.output: Returns nothing; the promise from startRecording resolves with the video file.

actions.name: toggleFacing()
actions.desc: Switches between the front and rear camera.
actions.output: Returns nothing; facing flips and viewProps carries it to the view.

actions.name: setLook(look)
actions.desc: Records a Look label in state. It does not change the image: Camera Looks belong to the Pixel Camera app and are not reachable from a third-party app.

inputs.name: look
inputs.desc: One of Original, Natural, Shadows, Vanilla, Editorial, Velvet, Classic, Digi, Black Tie, Minimal.

actions.output: Returns nothing; selectedLook updates so your own interface can show it.

actions.name: setZoom(fraction)
actions.desc: Sets zoom as a fraction of the lens range, not an optical multiplier.

inputs.name: fraction
inputs.desc: 0 to 1; values outside are clamped. Do not pass 5 for "5x".

actions.output: Returns nothing; zoomFactor updates and viewProps carries it to the view.

actions.name: setZoomStep(step, total?)
actions.desc: Evenly spaced zoom stops, for a control with discrete positions.

inputs.name: step
inputs.desc: Which stop to select, clamped to 0..totalSteps.

inputs.name: totalSteps
inputs.desc: How many stops there are. Defaults to 4.

actions.output: Returns nothing; sets zoomFactor to step / totalSteps.

actions.name: setFlash(mode)
actions.desc: Chooses flash behaviour for the next capture, as distinct from the continuous torch.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.desc: auto lets the camera decide by scene brightness.

actions.name: toggleTorch()
actions.desc: Turns the continuous light on or off through the preview. For torch without a preview, use useTorch.

actions.name: setMode(mode)
actions.desc: Switches the view between stills and video.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.desc: Recording requires video; startRecording switches it for you.

actions.output: Returns nothing; mode and viewProps update.

actions.name: pausePreview() / resumePreview()
actions.desc: Freezes or restarts the preview without tearing the camera down.
actions.output: Resolves once applied. Silently no-ops when the view has been unmounted.

actions.name: toggleUltraLowLightVideo()
actions.desc: Flips the UI flag only, for the same reason.

agentNote: Attach cameraRef to a mounted CameraView before calling capture, or it fails. zoom is 0..1, not a multiplier; do not pass 5 for "5x". Captures land in cache, so use useMediaLibrary().save() to keep them.
